title: Polytechnic Graduates who Dropped Out of SGUnited Traineeships Programme
what_it_is: Polytechnic Graduates who Dropped Out of SGUnited Traineeships Programme

sections.label: Polytechnic SGUnited Traineeships completion
sections.summary: About 720 Polytechnic graduates were placed into SGUnited Traineeships by end-December 2020, and 23 did not complete the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As of end-December 2020, about 720 Polytechnic graduates had been placed into SGUnited Traineeships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Of these, 23, or about 3%, did not complete the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For those who did not complete the programme, the reasons were mainly because they had found full-time employment, or had undisclosed personal or medical reasons.

sections.label: Traineeship sector relevance unknown
sections.summary: The speaker lacks information on whether polytechnic graduates chose traineeships relevant to their studies, while noting graduates have wide choices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Offhand, I do not have the information on whether the polytechnic graduates who opted for the traineeships are actually in sectors that are relevant to what they studied.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: But we do know that the Polytechnic graduates have a wide range of choices of traineeships.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We do encourage them to take on traineeships in sectors that are relevant to them, but we also encourage them to keep their options open and be ready to consider other choices as well.
